notes.title: Patch for 3/25/2025
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I've been rolling out some changes since the big update, I just finished off the last of them so here are the official patch notes.

Changes:
[list]
[*]Made the Fusions menu viewable from the Merchant shop (first, click on the bag in the shop to open your inventory)
[*]You can no longer buy more seeds than will max out your weapon level, fixing issues of accidentally over-buying weapon seeds and harvesting an undesired weapon after a fusion
[*]Adjusted shop rerolling to scale lower in price and cap out at a cost of 5000, allowing more attempts when trying to get specific weapons
[*]Fixed an issue where the game speed option could apply incorrectly in certain cases
[*]Fixed an issue where a farming plot could become stuck during harvesting and no longer be usable
[*]Reduced visual effect of the Dimensional Slash attack to make it less jarring
[*]Fixed cat animation flickering
[*]Adjusted weapon icons to be consistent across all UI in the game
[*]Added a dedicated ribbit button (because I just felt like it). Press 'R' on keyboard or D-Pad up on gamepad to use it
[*]Added Brazilian Portuguese and Spanish localization (separate announcement about this coming soon)!
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update - Weapon Fusions and Challenges!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We're super excited to launch this new content update and hear everyone's feedback.

This update brings a new mechanic into the game - weapon fusions! Upon maxxing out the two required weapons, you'll be presented with the option to fuse them into a new type of super-powered weapon. Weapon fusion info can be found at any time by clicking the new 'Fusions' option in the pause menu.

Along with this new mechanic, we have added 10 fusion weapons to the game:
[list]
[*]Dimensional Slash
[*]Shovel
[*]Meteor Smash
[*]Sweeping Slash
[*]Wind Bombs
[*]Mole Hat
[*]Fairy Tango
[*]Devil's Fork
[*]Tidal Wave
[*]Tadpole Burst
[/list]

We've also added new, extra-difficult challenges to the game for hardcore players to attempt. These challenges are only visible once all regular in-game achievements are completed. Get out there and fill up your trophy shelf if you dare face the task!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/1YFZ3kZm/spinnygif.gif[/img]

notes.title: Controller Crash Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Some players have been experiencing unusual crashes while playing on a controller, this bug is confirmed to have been an issue within the game engine we are using.

Thankfully, the issue has been recognized and fixed, this patch has an updated version which should fix this nasty bug!

If you continue to have any issues, please let me know!

notes.title: Patch for 05/01/2024 - Improved Resolution Support
notes.notes:
The main focus for this patch was getting the game to be playable on many different monitor resolutions with minimal compromise (Note: Vertical resolutions are not recommended)

- any resolution is now playable without black bars or limiting view
- made windowed mode freely resizable
- removed camera zooming in/out occurring on different resolutions
- fixed player health bar appearing in different positions relative to the character on certain resolutions
- fixed cursor-based movement joystick UI sizing inconsistencies on different resolutions
- damage numbers and boss health bars are now rendered smooth rather than pixelated for readability
- fixed odd formatting on the Pufferfish's compendium entry description
- improved Wood Axe weapon's base attack size, crit chance, attack frequency, and knockback
- changed timer for 5 second boss kill achievement to start only after the boss initially takes damage

Stay tuned for a content update coming later this month!

notes.title: What To Expect From Full Release
notes.notes:
We're now just 4 days away from release!! I wanted to take a moment to answer some questions and lay out what will be included in the full release of the game.

We've upheld our promise from the demo with the following content being included in the game (with a few extras, such as an additional character):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44347348/399a55b74377a5cda5e62fd59693900326c1ea49.png[/img]

We've also added 2 accessibility options that have been frequently requested:
[list]
[*]mouse-based character movement
[*]arachnophobia mode toggle
[/list]

Some other additions:
[list]
[*]alternate pet skins (18 total choices)
[*]customizable backyard garden with day/night cycle
[*]50 decor cosmetics unlocks to personalize your home and garden with
[*]improved menu UI highlighting clarity (as frequently requested)
[*]compendium that tracks ore and fish from each season
[*]revamped achievements display visuals
[*]revamped kitchen skill tree visuals
[*]a secret room in the house.. if you manage to unlock it 👀
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44347348/c7677e8ce1d5904c88d0e9b656b99737133b071e.png[/img]

One last thing I wanted to be clear about is that we will be going into full release rather than early access. We've had a long process to finally get here, but early on we committed to creating a fully fledged game with a ton of content before charging money for it. I know many players have been scarred from abandoned early access games and false promises, so we wanted to be sure to avoid any of that. We will be patching the game and adding new content in the future as well, but we got the game into the finished state we envisioned and don't want future promises to be the reason anyone decides to buy the game.

That's all for now, super excited to get the game into your hands in just 4 days!
